current_date: Revised checklist effective 6 January 2025 (approved changes announced 3 December 2024)
current_evidence: The council's Validation requirements page links this interactive checklist as the live list, and its per-type pages state the Design Code Checklist is 'required for applications submitted on or after 6 January 2025', matching the 3 Dec 2024 news item on the approved update; no newer list or PDF was found.

issues.detail: Grokbot marked the list 'Link only (not readable: blocked/404/login)' and captured 0 requirements, so every application type shows '(none)'. The tool is readable. The start page loads, and each application type has a fetchable details page (PlanningValidCheckListDetails.tmplt&AppTypID:PARAM=N, listed on planning.data.gov.uk entity 20076) that sets out national and local requirements with triggers.
issues.evidence: AppTypID=1 page: 'Advertisement Consent ... Existing/Proposed Elevations (Local) ... Elevations are required for all applications except those listed below as exceptions'
issues.claude_response: Grok could not verify this, so the finding stands until someone checks it by hand.

issues.detail: The List date 2024-04-01 ('adopted in April 2024') is the adoption date of the Design Code SPD, not of the validation checklist. The council's news item (3 Dec 2024) says the checklist update was approved and applies to applications from January 2025. The checklist pages give 6 January 2025. The previous revision was 2021.
issues.evidence: News 3 Dec 2024: changes apply to applications submitted from January 2025; 'Design Code SPD adopted in April 2024'; checklist last revised in 2021

issues.detail: Design Code Checklist was not captured. It is a local requirement confirming compliance with the mandatory codes of the Design Code SPD, for relevant applications submitted on or after 6 January 2025.
issues.evidence: Reserved Matters page: 'Design Code Checklist (Local) - Required for applications submitted on or after 6 January 2025'

issues.detail: Biodiversity/Ecological Assessment was not captured. It is required for: full non-domestic applications; domestic works disturbing the roof or roof structure, including loft conversions; works within a church curtilage; conservation area and listed building applications; LDCs for proposed use; outline and reserved matters; applications to vary or remove a condition; and sites where Priority Habitat is a constraint. It must include a protected species survey if species are likely. Surveys older than 18 months are out of date.
issues.evidence: High Hedge (AppTypID=6) page, Biodiversity/Ecological Assessment trigger list
issues.claude_response: Grok could not verify this, so the finding stands until someone checks it by hand.

issues.detail: Arboricultural Information was not captured. It covers a tree survey, AIA, Tree Protection Plan and AMS to BS5837:2012, required where trees could influence or be affected by development, especially on or next to TPO sites or in Conservation Areas.
issues.evidence: 'Required where trees could influence or be affected by the development ... Tree Preservation Orders and/or in Conservation Areas'
issues.claude_response: Grok could not verify this, so the finding stands until someone checks it by hand.

issues.detail: The local drawing requirements were not captured. Site plan (all applications except adverts on an existing building): metric scale, buildings and trees retained or removed, car and cycle parking, accesses and turning areas, visibility splays, and no 'do not scale' or 'approximate' annotations. Elevations: required for all applications except change of use without external alterations and vehicle crossovers; for adverts, show the height to the lowest part of the sign and the projection. Sections: where there is a sloping site, neighbouring land at a different level, or proposed level changes.
issues.evidence: Advertisement Consent and Reserved Matters detail pages, 'Existing/Proposed Site Plan', 'Existing/Proposed Sections'
issues.claude_response: Grok could not verify this, so the finding stands until someone checks it by hand.

issues.detail: Reserved matters local rule was not captured: the local requirements from the Full planning checklist apply where the information was reserved by condition or not fully provided at the outline stage. The January 2025 update also added BNG information (statutory 10% BNG) and encourages 3D visualisations for 10+ dwellings or 4+ storeys. None of this is reflected.
issues.evidence: RM page: 'Local requirements from the Full planning checklist ... if information was reserved by condition or not fully provided at the outline stage'; news 3 Dec 2024
issues.claude_response: Grok could not verify this, so the finding stands until someone checks it by hand.

issues.detail: URL source is given as the third-party planninggeek.co.uk directory and marked unverified. The URL is the council's own link: the 'Validation requirements' link on elmbridge.gov.uk/planning/planning-permission-and-applications/validation-requirements. The checklist covers 20 application types, including High Hedge, Deed of Variation, Prior Notification, PiP Technical Details and Telecommunications. These could be mapped to the workbook rows.

summary: Grokbot's link is the current official interactive checklist and it works, but Grokbot wrongly called it unreadable, captured nothing, and dated it April 2024 (the Design Code SPD date) instead of the update effective 6 January 2025. Local requirements such as the Design Code Checklist, Biodiversity/Ecological Assessment and Arboricultural Information are all missing. Only 3 of the 20 per-type pages were sampled in this audit.
